english.title: Land occupier make false statement in return made to paragraph 9 Schedule 15 notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been served with a notice under paragraph 9(1) of Schedule 15 to the Water Resources Act 1991, in a return made in pursuance of the notice, made a statement which you knew to be, or recklessly made a statement which was, false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSEHOOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 9(3)(b) and (c) and (4) of Schedule 15 to the Water Resources Act 1991.
